body.message: October 1 to December 31 is 3 months at AED 5,500/month. To secure the unit you'd pay the first and last month upfront (AED 11,000) plus a AED 1,000 refundable damage deposit, so AED 12,000 on day one, then AED 5,500 on November 1. Want to come see the place before we lock in the dates?
